# Bridge Hedges & Tree Services

> Local hedge cutting, hedge trimming, reduction and tree work in Bridge and the Nailbourne valley. Fully insured, nesting-season aware, conservation-area paperwork handled, fixed-price quotes.

Bridge Hedges & Tree Services is a working hedge and tree care business based in Bridge, Kent CT4. It is run by Richard Lim. Work is quoted at a fixed price after seeing photos and a postcode, and all arisings are cleared. Hedge cutting in Bridge starts from £120.

## Services

- [Hedge cutting](https://bridgehedges.co.uk/services/hedge-cutting.html): routine annual or twice-yearly hedge trimming for garden, boundary and formal hedges.
- [Hedge reduction](https://bridgehedges.co.uk/services/hedge-reduction.html): staged height and width reduction of overgrown hedges and leylandii.
- [Tree services](https://bridgehedges.co.uk/services/tree/): pruning, crown thinning, crown raising, crown reduction and deadwooding, with TPO and conservation-area applications handled.

## Areas served

Bridge and the Nailbourne valley (CT4). See the [areas page](https://bridgehedges.co.uk/areas/) for detail.
